title: Baste Duterte asks impeachment court to reset trial appearance
summary: The Davao mayor was directed to appear before the court and produce relevant records, including contracts with Gencorp

blocks.text: BASTE DUTERTE. Davao City Mayor Sebastian 'Baste' Duterte presides a meeting in this file photo taken in December 2025.
The Davao mayor was directed to appear before the court and produce relevant records, including contracts with Gencorp

items: Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte requested the Senate impeachment court to rest the date of his testimony at the impeachment trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, to gather necessary documents.
The court granted his request, allowing him to appear on September 29 or 30 instead of the originally scheduled date.
The impeachment trial involves the Davao City Hall's contracts with Gencorp Industries Inc., which has raised concerns about potential conflicts of interest related to Vice President Sara Duterte.

MANILA, Philippines – Davao City mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte has asked the Senate impeachment court to reset the date of his testimony in the impeachment trial of his older sister, Vice President Sara Duterte.

On Day 28 of the trial, on Monday, September 28, presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero said the court has received a letter from Duterte requesting to be allowed to “gather, organize, authenticate, and reproduce” the documents being subpoenaed by the court and to appear before the court on Tuesday, September 29, or Wednesday, September 30.

“The court was in receipt of a letter from Mayor Sebastian Duterte of the city of Davao dated today requesting that among others, that he be given time as he requires substantial time to gather, organize, authenticate, and reproduce the subpoenaed documents and asks that he be allowed to attend instead of today, tomorrow and on Wednesday,” Escudero.
“The presiding officer grants the request of mayor Duterte to appear tomorrow and Wednesday,” he said.

The Davao mayor was earlier subpoenaed to appear before the court from September 28 to September 30. He was also ordered to produce certified true copies of relevant official records in the custody of the Davao City government, including “all contracts and similar transaction records entered into from 2020 to the present with: Gencorp Industries Inc.; and any corporation or other entity that owns or operates a Jollibee branch or establishment.”

Gencorp was linked to the Vice President after it was found that she declared herself as a stockholder of the company in her 2022, 2023, and 2024 Statements of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALNs). However, her name did not appear as an incorporator or stockholder in Gencorp’s corporate records, according to Securities and Exchange Commission Director Gerardo del Rosario.

Rappler earlier reported that Gencorp secured P15.02 million in food and catering contracts from Davao City Hall and PhilHealth between 2022 and 2025, raising concerns about potential conflicts of interest. Mayor Duterte himself said that Gencopr cornered at least 19 contracts worth P33.26 million, and that that all these transactions followed government procurement laws.
He had also denied that Sara’s name or even the Duterte surname appeared in any of the company’s official documents submitted to the Davao City government.

The impeachment court initially directed the mayor to appear at the trial on Wednesday, September 23. However, it recalled the subpoena and reset his appearance in view of the oral arguments on the voting threshold. – Rappler.com
